title: Theme Customization Issues
description: Troubleshoot theme customization problems including CSS issues, layout problems, and customization not saving.
content:
Theme Customization Issues

This guide helps you troubleshoot common issues when customizing your store theme, including CSS problems, layout issues, and customization not applying.

Customizations Not Saving

Problems

  • Changes not persisting
  • Settings reverting
  • Save button not working

Solutions

  • Check browser console for errors
  • Verify you have edit permissions
  • Try different browser
  • Clear browser cache
  • Check network connection
  • Review error messages

CSS Not Applying

Issues

  • Custom CSS not working
  • Styles not updating
  • CSS conflicts

Solutions

  • Check CSS syntax
  • Verify CSS selector specificity
  • Clear cache
  • Use !important sparingly
  • Check for CSS conflicts
  • Validate CSS code

Layout Issues

Problems

  • Broken layout
  • Elements overlapping
  • Responsive design issues
  • Spacing problems

Solutions

  • Check theme compatibility
  • Review layout settings
  • Test on different devices
  • Verify responsive breakpoints
  • Check for conflicting styles
  • Reset to default if needed

Color Customization Issues

Problems

  • Colors not changing
  • Wrong colors displaying
  • Color picker not working

Solutions

  • Use correct color format (hex, RGB)
  • Clear cache after changes
  • Check color settings
  • Verify color values
  • Test in different browsers

Font Issues

Problems

  • Fonts not loading
  • Wrong fonts displaying
  • Font size issues

Solutions

  • Verify font names
  • Check font loading
  • Use web-safe fonts
  • Verify font file paths
  • Check font permissions

Image Issues

Problems

  • Images not displaying
  • Wrong images showing
  • Image sizing issues

Solutions

  • Check image URLs
  • Verify image uploads
  • Check image formats
  • Optimize image sizes
  • Review image settings

Mobile Responsiveness

Problems

  • Layout broken on mobile
  • Elements too small/large
  • Touch issues

Solutions

  • Test on actual devices
  • Check responsive breakpoints
  • Review mobile settings
  • Use responsive units (%, em, rem)
  • Test different screen sizes

Performance Issues

Problems

  • Slow page loading
  • Heavy customizations
  • Too many custom styles

Solutions

  • Optimize CSS
  • Minimize custom code
  • Use efficient selectors
  • Remove unused styles
  • Enable caching

Best Practices

  • Test changes in preview mode
  • Keep backups of customizations
  • Document custom changes
  • Use theme settings when possible
  • Avoid heavy customizations
  • Test on multiple browsers

Getting Help

If issues persist:

  • Review theme documentation
  • Check theme support
  • Contact theme developer
  • Contact Matjrii support
  • Share screenshots and details
